title: Elodie and the Inheritance
author: Jude Brightwater
blurb: Gideon Dravenmoor, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
